workflow.logging_policy: Snapshot-only: keep docs/project-state.json <= 8000 bytes, task summaries <= 320 chars, and <= 6 evidence items (<= 240 chars each). Never append historical daily benchmark logs.

current_capabilities.geometry_and_vector: Analytical curves/arcs, adaptive flattening, cubic/quadratic intersections, dynamic offset/contour, OSnap & inference engine, Pen tracing with Shift-only angle snapping and auto-commit to Node tool, direct segment bending (BendSegment) & multi-node curve conversion, Live Corners with single-step undo batching, Contour and Dimension controllers.
current_capabilities.document_and_color: Immutable snapshots, single-writer transactions, Undo/Redo, RGB/CMYK/Spot + Linear/Radial Gradient paint (ADR 0012), appearance effect graph (Gaussian Blur, Drop Shadow, Blend Mode, Opacity), Native v5 storage (kCurrentFormatVersion=5), backward-compatible v2/v3/v4 reading.
current_capabilities.rendering: Windows ViewportRenderer uses Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 hardware or WARP; full-frame staging/readback writes BGRA directly for GDI. Target/staging bitmaps are reused by size; object-local geometry survives pan/zoom, image uploads are bounded to 64 images/256 MiB. ICC preview and white page rendering are connected. SpatialIndex culls snapshots; DamageTracker limits GDI dirty copies. SoftwareRasterizer supports BGRA as CPU fallback/oracle; viewport guard is 32 MP.
current_capabilities.desktop_shell: Win32 Native Shell uses a shared DIP coordinate space for painting and hit testing, physical-resolution canvas targets, and WM_DPICHANGED font/cache/window updates. Page resizing preserves Undo/Redo; tool previews and per-tab save paths have regression coverage. Dirty tabs checkpoint every 60s under LOCALAPPDATA/PikDraw/Recovery with isolated per-session paths; successful save cleans only that tab.
current_capabilities.automation_ecosystem: Shared typed AutomationService, in-process MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint (verified NativeWindow E2E with Settings Copy URL/key and keyboard revoke), stdio MCP sidecar (pikdraw-mcp-server), and Windows COM IDispatch local server (pikdraw-com-server).
current_capabilities.external_vector_import: Real corpus verification: 4 CDR, 3 PDF, 1 PDF-compatible AI, and 2 EPS files imported to native objects, committed, and undone in test_pikdraw_desktop_import. CDR maps recognized layer IDs/transforms and retains affine image placements with shared raster pixels; PDF maps one tested OCG name and object marks when available; EPS imports path subset and converted DOS EPS. Import stops at 90% whole-system physical RAM with no fixed file-byte/pixel/process quota. Structural/wire/time/32-bit limits remain. PDF effects/clipping/rotation, multi-OCG membership, Corel live effects, coordinate oracle fidelity, source round-trip, production, and UI runtime remain unverified.

known_limitations: Qt 6 and Skia backends are future architectural targets pending unified MinGW/MSVC toolchain ABI; runtime currently standardizes on Win32 Native Shell + Direct2D 1.1 / D3D11 + WARP.

Interactive dragging reuses the cached native canvas and updates a small dirty copy when object bounds change; each changed snapshot is still fully rendered/read back by Direct2D. No GPU partial render, tile cache or direct swap-chain presentation is implemented.
DPI coverage uses synthetic 120/144/192/96 DPI events and native captures; physical monitor switching, reference-device latency and production fidelity remain unverified.
Autosave checkpoints use the UI writer synchronously; startup recovery selection UI is not implemented. Job Object memory/process/UI limits do not by themselves prove filesystem/network containment.

CDR uses pinned libcdr-to-SVG subset; PDF/AI are limited to first-page PDFium mapping and EPS uses eps-path-v1 or isolated Ghostscript conversion. PDF pages with nonzero rotation are rejected; effects/clipping, multiple OCG membership, Corel live effects, ICC fidelity, visual/coordinate oracle, all CDR versions, source round-trip, UI runtime, and production are not verified. Import monitors total physical RAM at a 90% stop threshold; structural/wire/time limits remain.
